pr_title: Fix Tuya fan speed conversion issue by ensuring string type
pr_body:
This PR fixes an issue with the Tuya fan integration where ordered_list_item_to_percentage() was receiving an integer instead of a string, causing incorrect behavior or errors.

Issue:
The function ordered_list_item_to_percentage(self._speeds.range, value) expected a string as input. However, value was an integer in some cases, leading to unexpected behavior. This was observed in Tuya fan devices where speed levels were returned as integers. Fix:
Wrapped value with str() to ensure it is always passed as a string: python
Copia
Modifica
return ordered_list_item_to_percentage(self._speeds.range, str(value)) This guarantees that the function receives the expected data type and works correctly. Impact:
Prevents potential errors when converting Tuya fan speed values. Ensures smooth operation of Tuya fans in Home Assistant.
